parts.label: Field magnet (N)
parts.note: Permanent magnets set up the field across the armature

parts.label: Field magnet (S)
parts.note: The field runs N to S through the armature

parts.label: Armature
parts.note: A slotted iron core that turns, carrying the coils

parts.label: Armature winding
parts.note: Current here feels a force: F = BIL on each side

parts.label: Commutator
parts.note: Split copper ring: flips coil current every half turn

parts.label: Carbon brush
parts.note: Presses on the commutator to feed in current

parts.label: Yoke
parts.note: Steel tube that holds the magnets and returns the flux

parts.label: Shaft
parts.note: Carries the torque out to the load
